title: 2019 AMC 12B Problem 7
statement: What is the sum of all real numbers \(x\) for which the median of the numbers \(4,\) \(6,\) \(8,\) \(17,\) and \(x\) is equal to the mean of those five numbers?

solutions.text:
The mean is \(\dfrac{4+6+8+17+x}{5}=\dfrac{35+x}{5}.\)

If \(x\le6,\) the median is \(6,\) so \(\dfrac{35+x}{5}=6\) gives \(x=-5,\) which is consistent.

If \(6\lt x\lt8,\) the median is \(x,\) so \(\dfrac{35+x}{5}=x\) gives \(x=8.75,\) not in range. If \(x\ge8,\) the median is \(8,\) so \(\dfrac{35+x}{5}=8\) gives \(x=5,\) not in range.

The only solution is \(x=-5,\) so the sum is \(-5.\)

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Split into cases by whether the median is \(6,\) \(8,\) or \(x\) itself
